caption: The drawing depicts a single dress viewed from the front, centered on a plain, cream-colored background. The dress features long, full sleeves gathered at the shoulders and cuffs, a fitted bodice with a deep V-neckline, and a wide, voluminous skirt that extends outward in an A-line shape. The garment appears to be fastened at the back of the neck, and the fabric is uniformly decorated with a repeating, tiny pattern of reddish-brown dots or small motifs, evenly spaced across the entire garment. The outlines and folds are rendered in fine lines, contributing to a sense of texture and volume. The colors primarily consist of faded cream or off-white for the base fabric with the accents in reddish-brown, and some subtle use of shading indicates the draping and gathers of the fabric. There are no additional objects or embellishments present in the composition.
title: Dress
